Europe in 1925 looks finished: new states, new borders and a League of Nations to keep the peace. Within 15 years almost every line here would be under attack.

a thread 🧵🗺️

1/ Look at the Baltic coast. The tiny Free City of Danzig was created by Versailles under League of Nations protection. About 90% German, it was tied to Poland for customs, foreign policy and railways, an awkward compromise.

2/ In October 1925 the powers met at Locarno. Germany accepted its western borders with France and Belgium, but gave no such guarantee for the east. The treaties were signed in London on 1 December, and Germany joined the League in 1926.
3/ To the south, Yugoslavia isn't called Yugoslavia yet. Officially it was the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes until 1929, when King Alexander abolished the constitution and renamed it.

4/ Albania became a republic in 1925 with Ahmet Zogu as president. Three years later he made himself King Zog. To the east, Turkey had been a republic since 29 October 1923, with its new capital at Ankara.
5/ In the west, the Irish Free State covered 26 of Ireland's 32 counties as a Dominion of the British Empire. It was founded on 6 December 1922 and lasted until 29 December 1937.
Locarno, Danzig or the Balkans: which line on this map looked most likely to break first? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
